messages:
ali: quick review of the prompt-sets approval UX — sharing Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def (compact-scorecard, approval-flow, filters)
sophia: a couple things stood out: 1) approval modal title says 'Approve prompts' but the audit log entry will show 'approved by <user>' 1 use consistent language between modal and audit. 2) mobile stacking flips CTA order unexpectedly.
noah: accessibility: filter chips have no focus ring on keyboard nav and the count badge has low contrast at 12px. also screen readers announce '1 items' due to pluralization bug.
jun: on the regression diff list, when you select a prompt set the right panel replaces previous selection without animation — jarring. propose a fade+slide to keep context. also, bulk approve currently lives in a row menu; recommend moving to a sticky toolbar at top for discoverability.
design-bot: automated checks: focus styles missing on filter chips, contrast fail for count badge, one missing aria-live on approval toast. See report: /reports/scan-1849123456.pdf
sophia: copy tweak proposals: modal header -> 'Confirm approval', confirm button -> 'Confirm and approve', single approve button stays 'Approve'. add small help text: 'This action is recorded in the audit log.'
alI: small UX: add undo in toast for single approves ('Approved 1 Undo') and require reason for bulk approves. keyboard shortcut idea: Shift+A opens bulk approve modal.
noah: dev note: pagination + filters currently collapse into 'More' when width < 900px. prefer a responsive pattern that keeps filters visible and collapses less-used controls.
jun: ticket list: #UX-4202 move bulk actions to toolbar, #UX-4203 animation for panel change, #FE-720 focus styles + pluralization fix, #A11Y-221 contrast for count badge.
sophia: I'll update figma with copy and small modal adjustments. added comments on the compact-scorecard frame.
design-bot: checklist added to tickets: focus-visible, aria-live, undo-toast, required-reason.
ali: thanks all 1 I'll split into two stories and tag frontend. If anyone wants to pair on the keyboard shortcuts ping me.
sophia: :thumbsup:
noah: running quick accessibility smoke now, will post if anything else shows up.
